description: A function prop that returns JSX, letting the caller decide what to render with the component's state: `<Mouse render={(pos) => ...} />`.
Render-prop variant where `children` is the function: `<Toggle>{({ on }) => ...}</Toggle>`.
Deeply nested callbacks when several render-prop components are combined. Hooks flatten it.
A render prop that is still idiomatic today: lists, tables and comboboxes let callers render each row or option.
